How to compare

Drag the slider to compare two observations. Look for a point that shifts relative to nearby stars.

Then reveal the expected position.

Use the arrow keys on the slider. Space switches dates in Blink mode. R toggles the overlay.

Pair evidence

The estimate uses catalog proper motion and elapsed time. It excludes parallax.
